classes.summary: DevicesMFE is a page object class for HP Smart Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) that extends SmartFlow. It implements the Page Object Model pattern with separation of verification flows and action flows. Notable patterns include: 1) String-based locator references passed to driver methods rather than direct element storage, 2) Consistent use of wait_for_object for element synchronization, 3) Separate verification and action method categories, 4) JavaScript executor usage for clicking non-displayed elements (click_close_button), 5) Keyboard interaction using Selenium Keys for page refresh (Ctrl+R), 6) Multi-screen popup navigation support for onboarding flows, 7) Alpha/workaround code for Windows dummy printer functionality, 8) Flexible timeout and exception handling parameters in verification methods, 9) Text retrieval methods for popup content validation, 10) Support for both visible and invisible element state verification.
